rationale: Bacteroides fragilis continues saccharolytic and proteolytic fermentation. Acetate and butyrate are abundant and well-utilized; amino acids provide limiting nitrogen (6 mmol/gDW/h in, 8 needed for growth). Growth is N-limited at 0.75 /h. Carbon balance: 62 mmol in, 30.75 for biomass, 31.25 for catabolic products (acetate, butyrate, formate, CO₂). Ammonium released from amino acid deamination.
